sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: Shapes and Patterns Chapter Chapter Weaving Mats You may have seen woven baskets of different kinds.
sections.source_evidence: Shapes and Patterns Chapter Chapter Weaving Mats You may have seen woven baskets of different kinds.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: If you look closely, you will notice different weaving patterns on each basket.
sections.source_evidence: If you look closely, you will notice different weaving patterns on each basket.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: We will try weaving some mats with paper strips.
sections.source_evidence: We will try weaving some mats with paper strips.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: You will need — A coloured paper (30 cm long and 20 cm wide) and eight paper strips of two different colours (3 cm wide and longer than 20 cm). (a) Take a coloured paper 30 cm long and 20 cm wide. (b) Fold the coloured paper in half along the longer side. (c) Draw vertical lines at equal distances from the closed end and cut slits leaving a gap of 3 cm at the top. (d) Carefully unfold the paper.
sections.source_evidence: You will need — A coloured paper (30 cm long and 20 cm wide) and eight paper strips of two different colours (3 cm wide and longer than 20 cm). (a) Take a coloured paper 30 cm long and 20 cm wide. (b) Fold the coloured paper in half along the longer side. (c) Draw vertical lines at equal distances from the closed end and cut slits leaving a gap of 3 cm at the top. (d) Carefully unfold the paper.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: There will be no cuts in the paper at the top and the bottom. (e) Now cut 8 paper strips of 3 cm width in 2 colours and of length slightly longer than 20 cm. (f) Take one colour strip and weave it across the slits going 1 under and 1 over, and again 1 under and 1 over.
sections.source_evidence: There will be no cuts in the paper at the top and the bottom. (e) Now cut 8 paper strips of 3 cm width in 2 colours and of length slightly longer than 20 cm. (f) Take one colour strip and weave it across the slits going 1 under and 1 over, and again 1 under and 1 over.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: Repeat it for the first row. (g) Take one more strip of another colour and weave it across the slits going 1 over and 1 under, and again 1 over and 1 under.
sections.source_evidence: Repeat it for the first row. (g) Take one more strip of another colour and weave it across the slits going 1 over and 1 under, and again 1 over and 1 under.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: Repeat it for the second row. (h) Weave all the strips in the same alternating pattern.
sections.source_evidence: Repeat it for the second row. (h) Weave all the strips in the same alternating pattern.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: Neatly fold any extra strip ends behind the mat.
